reason: The short mode (212-243 aa) is Avibirnavirus/Aquabirnavirus/TV-1 and is correct. The long mode is now a single genome, Largemouth bass birnavirus at 314 aa (2 identical deposits). Corrected 21 Nov 2026: this row previously also covered Blotched snakehead virus at 305 aa and asserted that both modes were 'validated at both ends'. That was wrong. qc_cross_feature found the BSNV projected member 100% identical over its first 71 residues to fig|311176.4.mat_peptide.6, the deposited X peptide -- the projection had started at the pVP2|X junction instead of the X|VP4 junction, because in BSNV the polyprotein is pVP2-X-VP4-VP3 (PMID 12477876) and the projection skipped X. The 71 aa prefix was trimmed; the member is now 234 aa, which is both the published BSNV VP4 size and the length implied by X's own C-terminal A|A -- two independent confirmations. It had its own single-sequence cluster and therefore its own profile, so uncorrected it would have called VP4 on X's locus in every BSNV-lineage genome. Largemouth bass birnavirus is left at 314 aa: it deposits no X peptide, its one internal A|[AS] would imply a 49 aa X rather than a 71 aa one, and no publication places a cut there. Projecting one would be invention, so the length stands and is recorded as a known uncertainty.
